config.script:
try:
		data = self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.data
		headers = self.view.params.dataColumnList
		fileName = 'Export_'+str(self.view.params.parentViewName)
		
		#headers = []
		values = []
		
#		for col in columndata:
#			headers.append(str(col['field']))
			
		for item in data:
			vals = []
			for colName in headers:
				vals.append(item[colName]['value'])
			values.append(vals)
		
		dataset = system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, values)
		exportDatasetT = system.dataset.toExcel(1, dataset)
		system.perspective.download('%s_%s.xlsx' %(fileName, str(system.date.now())), exportDatasetT)
	except Exception, errorMessage:
		system.perspective.print('Error on btnExport : '+str(errorMessage))

self.view.custom.dataSource.table.selection.col = None
	self.view.custom.dataSource.table.selection.row = None
	
	import time
	time.sleep(0.5)
	
#	self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("flxEdit").position.display = True
	self.view.custom.dataSource.create = True
	
	return
